info.title: Kiddies Check API
info.description:
REST API for Kiddies Check.

1. Call `POST /api/auth/login` to get a token.
2. Click **Authorize** and paste the token.
3. Use **Try it out** on any endpoint.

_Generated from `src/app/api` by `npm run docs:generate`._

post.summary: Records a manual payment (cash, transfer, POS...). Body: { amount, method, reference, paidAt, note, notifyParent } or { payFullBalance: true, ... } Payments larger than the outstanding balance are rejected. Unless notifyParent is false, the receipt is emailed to the parent/guardian.

post.summary: { schoolId, billIds: [], action, ...options } mark-paid       — records a payment for each bill's full outstanding balance record-payment  — { amount } recorded on each bill, capped at its balance discount        — { amount, discountType: "fixed" | "percent", reason } waive           — { reason } unwaive Payment actions also accept { method, reference, paidAt, note, notifyParent } and email each parent a receipt unless notifyParent is false.
